description: This file defines the PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator class responsible for managing the lifecycle of a PeekabooBridge server host and its associated services within a macOS application. It handles starting, stopping, and setting up socket symlinks, as well as obtaining the current team ID for security purposes. Additionally, it includes the implementation of services required for PeekabooBridge functionality.

classes.name: PeekabooBridgeHostCoordinator
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle of a PeekabooBridge host and its services, including socket management and security contexts.

classes.name: OpenClawPeekabooBridgeServices
classes.description: Provides various services such as permissions, screen capture, automation, window management, and application control for PeekabooBridge.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the PeekabooBridge host asynchronously.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the host if it is running and clears references.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Initializes and starts the host if it isn't already running.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlinks
methods.description: Creates symbolic links for legacy socket paths.

methods.name: ensureLegacySocketSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link at the specified legacy path, replacing existing links or files.

methods.name: currentTeamID
methods.description: Retrieves the current code's signing team identifier for security purposes.
